subject: OPEN-LOOP-FAILCLOSES landed 4cdd779 — CQR empty, 5pp market, Venn-by-sport, discrete CRPS
body:
SHA 4cdd779 on hermes/2026-09-18-queues. SHADOW. No MODEL_VERSION. No production fire.

1. CQR empty (apps/web/lib/calibration/cqr.ts). The remaining hole after conformalQuantile already returned +∞: cqrInterval([]) returned qhat:0 and the original [qLo,qHi] unchanged. That is fake tightness. Empty / rank>n-1 now returns licensed:false, qhat +∞, intervals ±∞. The old cqr.test.ts still expected the clamp (n=5 α=0.1 → 0.8); rewritten. Expansion identity kept on n=20 where the quantile exists. No production caller of cqrInterval besides tests.

2. Production refusal census. Still no DB. censusTrueProbRows / summarizeTrueProbAdmission format the existing mill. dbQueried is always false. Empty throws rather than printing a 0% refusal rate that would read as 'production is clean'. A zero on this mill is not a Neon measurement.

3. 5pp market-violation mill. Named tolerance 0.05, 10 equal-width bins, min n=30 per bin. Underpowered bins are not violations and not a pass. Per-sport cards. Empty throws. We did not invent a production 5% number — the mill is how a caller with settled (sport, marketP, y) rows measures it.

4. Venn Δp sport-stratified. measureVennWidthBySport(rows, cap). A global 0.20 on synthetic NFL-wide / NBA-tight rows is a sport lottery (NFL veto 1, NBA veto 0, flag true). maxWidthForFire stays caller-supplied and off. FLASH_VENN_WIDTH_MEASURE cites flash/20260918T194145225Z-669d (median 0.024, 23% overall / 40% NFL) — citation, not a re-run.

5. Discrete CRPS vs widened Gaussian. compareNflKeyNumberVsGaussian: y ~ key-number mixture (±3,±7 bump), model A = mixture, model B = discretised N(0,14). Discrete ranking A. Gaussian closed form uses N(0,14) for BOTH so it ties and cannot see the bump. gaussianLicensedAsKill is false. gaussianGate.verdict is kill (improvement 0). Discrete is the primary for integer scores.

Verify: prediction-engine vitest 26/26 on the new files + tsc clean. apps/web CQR 9/9.

Still not done, honestly: Neon refusal census (needs a loader), 5pp violation on real settled rows, Venn width on real IVAP widths (flash's 40% NFL stands until a caller re-runs), discrete vs Gaussian on nflverse margins. STEAM-CURVATURE remains opus. CQR still defaultOff.
